name: <NYI> <TXT> The Gadgetzan Run
objectiveText: Escort Petra and Dadanga!   Escort Petra and Dadanga!  ( 1 )

comments.body: Didn't make it out of Beta,  but looks like you had to escort [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=9273/petra-grossen]Petra[/url] and [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=9274/dadanga]Dadanga[/url] probably from Gagetzan to the camp at Un'goro? Given that both zones are contested, it's not surprizing such a long escort quest was dropped
